title: Premonitions and/or Synchronicity involving Mallworld Dreams?
content: Have any of you ever correctly predicted something because of your mallworld dream or feel like you got a vision into the future? I had a very lucid mallworld dream a couple nights ago about it being as bright as day at exactly 12:00am in my mallworld. The mall had an area where they were promoting a Mortal Kombat movie (which there is one that comes October 24 of this year) My synchronicity happened watching the Why FIles, which I had not seen an episode of in at least 4 months. It was about Carrington Events, which are sever solar flares that can cause quite a bit of damage depending of severity, and in the video (that was shot early 2024) the host mentioned 2025 having a high chance of there being a big one. In fact, i finished his sentence when he said when the next big one was happening, because of my dream. These Carrington events do brighten the sky like it is morning, even if it is night where you live when it occurs. It was weird that of all the episodes, that was the one that Youtube picked out for me after I selected an episode about time travel. Also noted that I also had a Meghan Trainor song (lol, not even my preferred style of music btw) in my head the same morning and in the next episode Hucklefish (from same show) sang it. Hadn't seen that episode before either. I didn't experience any mass destruction, but my dream ended when I tripped out that it was midnight in the dream. If there is one that happens on or a month or two before October 24, that would really be a trip and I hope it is a minor one. Sorry if this comes off as schizo posting. tldr: hoping my dream about a carrington event on or just before october 24 is not a premonition even though i had unusual synchronicities after I woke up. What are your experiences?
